title: Clip manifest
description: What the app plays: sentences, model runs and their clips. Clip paths are relative to clip_base (default: the manifest's own folder).

clip_base.description: URL prefix for clip paths; defaults to the manifest URL's folder

words_source.description: Where word references come from (may also be set per sentence)

items.description: Text fields are named by config.fields (display, secondary, gloss); any extra fields are ignored

words.description: Optional per-word reference; without it, words are split from the display text and annotators type syllables and IPA themselves

text.description: The word as displayed (a `nikud` field is also accepted)

ipa_ref.description: Reference IPA, prefilled as the expected IPA

stress_ref.description: 0-based index into syllables, preselected as the correct stress

slug.description: Stable run id; annotations key on it

run.description: Free-form run metadata; `input` is shown and saved
